notes: Normal user (no special authority; role has only M_dhis-web-capture etc.) can create own PAT. No PAT-related authority exists in 2.42.
Minimal body {} also works: type defaults to PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2, expire defaults to now+30 days.
expire is epoch milliseconds. 400 days and a past timestamp were both accepted (no server-side max/min validation observed).
type must be PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_V1|PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2; an invalid enum gives HTTP 500 with Jackson message.
Key is returned only here: response.key (format d2p_ + 50 chars). response.uid is the token object id (used for DELETE /api/apiToken/{uid}). Key redacted in this fixture.
